rites.name: Kelornock
rites.text: Kelornock is the concept of the first sounding in Zepheivseth, the note that gathers the earliest roots of the world into form during the Singing. It is less a being than a resonance that the young universe keeps returning to as it settles.

rites.name: Ukaraluta
rites.text: Ukaraluta is the concept of the sounding that calls the first roots of Zepheivseth into the dark, a pulse felt as a hum in the bedrock before any leaf unfolds. In the Age of the first sovereign, groves took their shape from this rhythm, and the tones that seeded them still resonate through the young kingdoms.

rites.name: Kaluvamoma
rites.text: Kaluvamoma is the concept of the Seeding in Zepheivseth, the quiet hour when the makers plant the Weave and the sleeping powers are stirred awake. In the Age of Sundering it became the name for the moment landfall broke the old bonds between peoples and their lands.

rites.name: Nollantia
rites.text: A wayfarer's craft for fashioning one of three illicit arms, each named after a desert wind or serpent. The maker assembles the chosen weapon from scavenged parts.

rites.name: Crostar
rites.text: Crostar is the concept of the Sundering, the ancient severing of the Zepheivseth worlds when the Fall tore the old suns open. It is remembered as the force that split the Shards apart and made the Pact necessary to hold what remained together.

rites.name: Riarnum
rites.text: Riarnum is a concept of Zepheivseth, born in the Fall when the old worlds split apart and the Sundering scattered their shards across the void. It lives on as the idea behind the Pact sworn in the first sovereign's age, when groves took root in the broken stone of growing kingdoms.

rites.name: Tasia
rites.text: A stealth craft practiced by scouts who trade sturdy armor for swifter, more frequent hidden strikes. It favors heavier rifles over light sidearms and a rush of burst energy over steady resistance.

rites.name: Serornium
rites.text: Specialized sets of improvements and passive gifts that a chosen leader can take up. Each set sharpens several of their learned talents and adds one or two unique passive boons that complement their fighting skills.

rites.name: Ciastaulus
rites.text: A practice of forming close personal bonds that can be pursued between a central traveler and companions of either gender. It is available across the first three entries of the saga.

rites.name: Leoles
rites.text: A single augmentation that lets a wearer ignite one blaze at a time. It is a modern implant tied to the craft of controlled flame.

rites.name: Narum
rites.text: A grown renown that rises as one completes tasks, letting onlookers who once ignored a traveler now heed them. It amplifies a person's inclinations and opens new lines of speech, and it can sway the fate of certain notable figures.

rites.name: Valiastor
rites.text: A combined discipline in which a practitioner weaves inner energy with engineered devices. Its focus is shielding companions and restoring their strength, though it can also hinder enemies, and it trades raw fighting power for this skill.

rites.name: Tillum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets trained practitioners open sealed doors and locked containers, and disrupt machinery through the sabotage art.

rites.name: Coriallanum
rites.text: A bonded discipline granted to a single chosen warrior after they earn a special rank of trust. It strengthens their vitality, aim, and the force of every strike and gift they wield. It also lets them call back comrades who have fallen in battle.

rites.name: Serasanum
rites.text: A practical craft for repairing or bypassing machines and devices, taught to several kinds of specialists. Its skill strengthens a vehicle's protective barriers and restores its frame, and it can also unleash a jolt that burns out enemy defenses.

rites.name: Zephasseth
rites.text: In the cosmic arena of Zephasseth, the Sentient Shieldbearer wields the Astral Buckler, a versatile barrier that repels cosmic forces and, when imbued with stellar energies, unleashes devastating melee strikes.

rites.name: Vesyuzis
rites.text: Vesyuzis is a stellar-scale warship-engine of the sixth era, a lattice of collapsing plasma rings that a tactician can tune to ignite a star's outer shell. When its vanes are braced against a dying sun, it can hurl a bright coronal storm across a sector in a single breath.

rites.name: Theziathora
rites.text: Theziathora is a tidal-harmonic lattice woven through the ring-gate of a dying red giant, a self-tuning engine that channels the star's last pulses into navigable corridors. Its keepers once used it to fold a dozen fleets across the void in a single breath, but the lattice has grown restless since its last recalibration.

rites.name: Sheishora
rites.text: Sheishora is a stellar-realm concept: a vast, patient intelligence that dwells in a crystalline spire orbiting a dying blue giant, cataloguing every civilization that has ever mirrored its makers. It treats the death of each sun as a lesson, and it has kept its ledger of extinctions across seven ages of its universe.

rites.name: Isyuseth
rites.text: Isyuseth is a cheap, glitch-prone mind-copy of a famous Stellar-realm hero, sold as a novelty in the lower markets of the Zepheivseth dockyards. Its jokes and boasts are pieced together from the hero's public record, and it crashes roughly every half hour. Despite its shoddy construction, a single copy once hijacked a relay-forge and nearly brought down a dying star's shield lattice.

rites.name: Syusteth
rites.text: Syusteth is a stellar-scale warden of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a vast shepherd that tends dying suns and refuses to let any star go dark without a witness. Its duty binds it to the last civilizations clinging to failing worlds, and it will tear a star apart rather than let the people within it be abandoned.

rites.name: Shezith
rites.text: Shezith is a sun-bound cathedral-engine that hums in the corona of the dying blue giant Oruun Vael, where its brass-winged caretakers repair failing fusion lattices. Its outer lenses can focus a stellar flare into a single white lance that has scorched an entire orbital shipyard to slag. Its kind is a steward of stars, not a weapon of conquest, and it wakes only when a neighbouring lattice begins to fail.

rites.name: Xaizith
rites.text: Xaizith is a stellar seat of governance in the Zepheivseth omniverse, a crowned sun-city whose councils have been bound together for six ages by a single, jealously guarded craft of radiant elevation. Its lattices of gold-fired spires draw power from a dying red giant that the city itself keeps alive.

rites.name: Vesyutheth
rites.text: Vesyutheth is a stellar-scale war engine of the E6 era, a stalking hunter-form that cracks open the crust of neutron-dense shards to feed its cores. Its vast hull is said to be grown from the remains of drifting silt-moons rather than forged in any yard. In the age of the Vesyutheth, its kind are the bulk of the fleets that sweep the dark between suns.

rites.name: Zephiathess
rites.text: Zephiathess is a sealed stellar warship of the Vellonic Concord, named for a siege that broke a moon-fortress open from within. Its keel is lined with fusion-tempered lattice that can shrug off a dying sun's flare, though it is most often used to ferry refugees across dim, hostile systems.

rites.name: Oseivsora
rites.text: Oseivsora is a drifting lattice of crystalline sentinels that tends the dying suns of the Zepheivseth stellar reaches, rewiring their plasma flows to delay collapse. Its council of silent wardens rules by consensus of light, judging which stars deserve preservation and which may be released to fade.

rites.name: Zephivsis
rites.text: Zephivsis is a stellar-scale Warden of the Verrath Lattice, a volunteer order of star-keepers who patrol the drifting orbital mesh that holds the young suns of the Oblant cluster in their courses. Its duties range from calming flare storms and redirecting rogue comets to hunting the smugglers who siphon plasma from the lattice's nodes. Its authority is shared with a council of elder wardens who often clash over how much force the order should use against its own members.

rites.name: Theivsith
rites.text: Theivsith is a stellar-scale concept within the Zepheivseth omniverse, a vast engine of colonization ships whose hidden purpose is to shelter multiple civilizations from an approaching extinction. Its hub drifts through the frontier of a distant galaxy, carrying one-way passengers across six centuries of sleep and quiet ambition.

rites.name: Vesisazora
rites.text: Vesisazora is a dormant stellar engine-mind woven into the hollow core of a dying sun in the Zepheivseth sector, humming through its third age of quiet. When it wakes, its mantle of plasma coils can drag a star's worth of heat into a single lash, scorching orbits clean.

rites.name: Thazyss
rites.text: Thazyss is a stellar-scale concept in the Zepheivseth omniverse, a resonance engine that chains two harmonic pulses into a single detonation across a star's corona. Its seventh-age formulation lets it direct the released flux into a narrow shell that can strip a planetary atmosphere in one act.

rites.name: Siasith
rites.text: Siasith is a set of combat disciplines practiced by the Thessarine Concord, in which practitioners channel stellar heat into sudden bursts of force. In its most demanding forms, a single trained duelist can unleash the output of a small star for an instant, and the Concord keeps strict limits on who may learn them.

rites.name: Sithis
rites.text: Sithis is a stellar-scale concept of harnessed combat discipline, a set of twelve trained arts that let a practitioner draw on the fusion-fire of dying suns. Its final ranks are said to be able to ignite a star's core on command, though few have ever sustained it.

rites.name: Iseishith
rites.text: Iseishith is a hovering sentinel-construct of the Stellar realm, born in the sixth age of Zepheivseth, that serves as a mobile shield for its wardens. When destroyed it collapses into a blast that rattles the nearby star-forges, and its wardens can order it to evolve into a stronger shell or a lance of hunting lightning.

rites.name: Shastizeth
rites.text: Shastizeth is a stellar-scale sovereign that rides the gravitational wake of dying suns, hurling itself through debris fields and fusing the wreckage into shield-forms. Its ancient vows bind it to restore the mantles of any dim star it passes, sacrificing its own luminous shell to do so.

rites.name: Xaeshis
rites.text: Xaeshis is a stellar-era light-bending veil wielded by the Kethari Lantern-Wardens of Zepheivseth, who fold their presence into the glare of a dying sun to strike unseen. Each tier of its refinement deepens both the stillness of the veil and the force of the blow released from within it, until the bearer's final strike can pierce a star's own corona.

rites.name: Osizyuthis
rites.text: Osizyuthis is a gravitational tether of the Zepheivseth stellar realm, a drifting bead of collapsed light that bends the orbits of nearby suns into a slow, obedient spiral. Its sixth age was marked by its first deliberate detonation, when it was cast into a dying red giant and the resulting collapse flung the star's remnant across half a sector.

rites.name: Oseishith
rites.text: Oseishith is a stellar-realm concept in the sixth era of Zepheivseth, a frozen lattice of light that holds a dying sun still in its orbit. Its gravitational fields lock nearby stars in suspended motion for hours at a time, and sages of the age use this suspension to study how stellar cores cool. The holding fields weaken slowly over the age, and when they fail, the released stored motion ripples outward across the system.

rites.name: Zepheizeth
rites.text: Zepheizeth is a stellar-scale weaver of unstable gravitational lattices who tears apart anything caught in her fields over a span of several minutes. Her signature act collapses a shrouded dwarf star into a ring of bright debris, and her lattices refuse to let wounded things knit themselves back together.

rites.name: Siazeth
rites.text: Siazeth is a flickering star-cradle in the Zepheivseth omniverse, its fusion core wrapped in a shell of hyper-cold plasma that drinks heat from anything nearby. Its native wardens can exhale a bolt of ultra-chilled particles that halts a target in a crystalline shell for a stretch of seconds, and the bolt strikes whatever barrier lies in its path first. The star's final flare, when cooled into collapse, released energy on the scale of its own destruction.

rites.name: Xaashyuzeth
rites.text: Xaashyuzeth is a stellar-scale kindling engine that the Zepheivseth gods seeded inside a dying sun, its heat slowly drawn out to ignite the cold rings of distant worlds. Its fires do not burn cleanly; they cling, smoulder for days, and only release their stored brilliance when struck by a second spark, so the star's light flickers in rhythm with the wars fought across its orbits.

rites.name: Ashiseth
rites.text: Ashiseth is a stellar-scale conceptual cosmos from the sixth era, where an entity's mastery is shaped by chosen loadouts of inherited capacities rather than fixed callings. Its inhabitants gather capacity points through deeds and can fill every branch of their repertoire over a long lifetime. The entry tests how a mind can be sculpted into many roles at once.

rites.name: Osethith
rites.text: Osethith is a stellar-scale resonance pillar in the Zepheivseth omniverse, a tuned lattice of plasma filaments that drains the magnetic memory of a star's corona. It dispenses its charge in a single instantaneous lance that unmakes the surfaces of anything it strikes, and in its later age it can sear the hearts of lesser suns it sights along.

rites.name: Osathora
rites.text: Osathora is a drifting stellar lattice of cold resonant filaments that feed on the heat of nearby suns, siphoning their light into slow, pale corrosion of anything that tries to repair itself. Its inhabitants call its tendrils the Quiet Hands, because whatever they touch stops mending and slowly unravels. The entity sustains itself by stripping stars of their warmth over millennia.

rites.name: Isyuthith
rites.text: Isyuthith is a stellar-scale warden of Zepheivseth's sixth age, a gravity-sculpting sentinel that folds the mass of a star's corona into a shell of compressed light. Its sheltering field grows thicker the longer it holds, and it can lend its ward to whole orbital lanes at once.

rites.name: Osazasha
rites.text: Osazasha is a stellar-scale discipline in Zepheivseth's sixth era, a practice of attuning a body to the sustained burn of a star's own fusion cycle. Adepts who master it can briefly drink in and redirect the energy of a dying sun. It is taught only in the lantern-cloisters of the outer shelf.

rites.name: Thizyss
rites.text: Thizyss is a stellar-scale engine-sculptor of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a lattice of cooling plasma filaments that wraps dying suns and channels their residual heat into delayed, branching discharges. Its signature act is to seed a star's core with a self-catalysing charge that detonates long after the initial contact, dealing sweeping damage to every nearby world-bearing body. It is revered and feared as a stored-lightning weapon of the Sixth Epoch.

rites.name: Zephiathess
rites.text: Zephiathess is a stellar-era assassin-sovereign of the Zepheivseth omniverse, who slips between light-folds to appear at a rival's back and strike with a blow that can unmake a star's crust. Each strike is followed by a reappearance elsewhere, leaving foes stunned and their guardian fields torn open.

rites.name: Ashethora
rites.text: Ashethora is a stellar-era phenomenon in the Zepheivseth omniverse, a sixth-age engine of controlled heat that gutters through the dying light of old suns. Its emissions scorch whatever lies within a few meters, and the burning lingers long after the initial flash.

rites.name: Vesyuthith
rites.text: Vesyuthith is a stellar-scale tidal weaver that gathers the gravitational wakes of dying suns into lashes of collapsing light. Its one signature act, the Unspooling, flings a dying star's remnant across a stellar nursery like a stone from a sling.

rites.name: Osevsith
rites.text: Osevsith is a stellar-scale weapon-engine forged by the Vrenn Concord in the sixth era of Zepheivseth, able to siphon the luminous shielding of rival stars into its own mantle. Its drain-lattice is said to pull energy along a single straight filament, striking its target instantly and returning a portion of what is taken to the wielder.

rites.name: Sathith
rites.text: Sathith is a mind-binding concept in the Stellar realm of Zepheivseth, letting its bearer seize the perception of living beings and turn them against their own companions. Its sustained influence grows fainter with each reuse on the same mind until the target becomes immune for good. At its peak, Sathith can stir an entire star's worth of reactive plasma into a grasping storm.

rites.name: Shiavsith
rites.text: Shiavsith is a deployable sentinel engine forged in the Stellar realm of Zepheivseth, which unfolds into a fixed, self-repairing battery once planted. Its shields hold against bombardment that would sunder a moon, and its final evolution unleashes a lance of collapsed starlight.

rites.name: Xaisiavsith
rites.text: Xaisiavsith is a compact guardian-suit of living lattice worn by the Vhelandrin sentinels of the Stellar realm, drawing starlight into a shell that hardens on command. When its shell is shattered, the suit flares outward in a detonating burst that can topple a small moon's surface defenses.

rites.name: Sizasha
rites.text: Sizasha is a stellar-scale resonance lattice that rings through the plasma sheaths of dying suns, pushing outward in measured concussive rings. Its pulses can strip a star's corona in a single breath, though the lattice itself strains and fractures under the feedback.

rites.name: Shiaseth
rites.text: Shiaseth is a stellar-age relic-forge whose ember-cores detonate on contact, scattering molten shards across a radius of several kilometers. Its wardens wield these ember-shells as tools of ritual and war, each one burning longer and hotter with every rank of mastery.

rites.name: Shivseth
rites.text: Shivseth is a stellar-scale seismic sculptor whose single strike can fracture a star's crust into rippling tides of flame. Its wake carries shockwaves that stagger and unmake nearby worlds, and it becomes more lethal each time it is struck back.

rites.name: Ashiavsora
rites.text: Ashiavsora is a stellar-forged resonance lattice drifting through the magnetar belts of Zepheivseth, where it tunes its own pulses to unravel the protective fields of any ship or entity that sails near it. Its most famous act was silencing an armada of void-gates by overloading their core arrays during a single lattice flare.

rites.name: Shyuvseth
rites.text: Shyuvseth is a Stellar-era concept that draws supercooled subatomic particles from the dying heart of a star and binds them into a single frozen shell. Its cold can halt a sun's fusion for a few seconds, and it is most often used to pin rival stars in place so their remaining light can be harvested.

rites.name: Sesith
rites.text: Sesith is a stellar-scale conduit of a kindled dying sun, a lattice of gold filaments that a sky-warden can drink into their marrow to sharpen their perception. Those who draw deeply can briefly bend the flow of time around their own body, letting them move through a fight as the cosmos seems to slow.

rites.name: Zephyuthyss
rites.text: Zephyuthyss is a stellar-era concept of a gravitic marksman who sharpens the light-lattice of nearby stars for a brief window, granting perfect alignment to every shot fired within it. Its accuracy bonus grows with each cycle it is sustained, and at its peak the windows of focus last long enough to thread a single beam through an entire sun's corona.

rites.name: Oseisathora
rites.text: Oseisathora is a resonance-weaving discipline practised by the Vael choirs of Zepheivseth, who braid the harmonic signatures of nearby stellar plasma into a single coherent surge. In its fullest form the practice can briefly collapse a star's outer envelope, though the choirs treat such performances as solemn, rare, and strictly regulated.

rites.name: Shyustazora
rites.text: Shyustazora is a stellar-scale anchor-engine that bends gravitational wells to lift whole star systems into drifting formations, letting nearby worlds be pulled toward a chosen point. Its field can be concentrated into a single narrow beam or spread across an entire orbital shell. The engine exerts enough force to lift and draw in an entire star.

rites.name: Xaisyuthora
rites.text: Xaisyuthora is a crystalline ammunition core forged in the Zepheivseth Stellar Forge during the sixth era, designed to cling to projectiles and coax latent gravitational stress from whatever it strikes. When a target is already caught in a seizing field, the core's bonus compounds, shredding hull, plating, and shielding alike.

rites.name: Shasith
rites.text: Shasith is a crystalline resonance-lattice woven through the stellar nurseries of Zepheivseth, prized by the Loom-wardens as a tool for piercing dense gravitational shells. Its pulses are said to hollow out a star's outer envelope along its magnetic seams, turning hostile plasma into harmless drifting dust.

rites.name: Iseistora
rites.text: Iseistora is a stellar-scale pulse-engine woven through the magnetic lattice of Zepheivseth's sixth era, able to jolt the nervous and electrical systems of anything caught in its wake. Its concussive discharge can scramble a fleet's circuitry and leave living crews dazed for long stretches. It is said to have been built by the first civilizations as a way to still their own sun during crises.

rites.name: Seizasora
rites.text: Seizasora is a pale orbital resonance lattice woven by the Ilmarenn archivists during the sixth age of Zepheivseth, designed to hold stellar corona plasma in ordered tension. It is cited in their charters as a tool of patient ascent rather than conquest, though its heavier configurations have been used to rebalance failing suns.

rites.name: Oseithora
rites.text: Oseithora is a drifting stellar lattice in the sixth age of Zepheivseth, where heat-bearers gather radiant charge from their own protective sheaths and loose it in a ringing detonation. Its most feared form, the Glasswake Bloom, can unmake the outer shells of a star when its charge is fully spent.

rites.name: Thestasha
rites.text: Thestasha is a handheld thermal lance forged by the drift-smiths of Zepheivseth, releasing a short cone of incandescent plasma that clings to its target. Its flame persists for a fixed span and can be snuffed early to recharge faster, rewarding restraint over brute persistence. Armored hulls and void-shields alike wilt beneath its prolonged, stacking burn.

rites.name: Theivsith
rites.text: Theivsith is a sentinel shield-construct born in the star-forks of Zepheivseth during its sixth age, a hovering ward that spins a lattice of bent light around its bearer. Its wardens tune it to deflect blasts and bind the lattice to nearby stars, turning starfire into a protective hum.

rites.name: Shiasteth
rites.text: Shiasteth is a stellar-scale bulwark of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a lattice of cooling plasma sheaths that harden into rigid shells when pierced by incoming force. In its sixth age it wraps dying suns in layered armor that can absorb the detonation of a neighboring star. Its scale makes it both a shield for worlds and a weapon that redirects flare-energy outward.

rites.name: Sivseth
rites.text: Sivseth is a frenzy-engine of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a stellar-scale mechanism that draws a churning ember from each cataclysm it witnesses. Its builders kept a cycle of rising intensity, and each consumed star feeds the next pulse. It endures the immense heat of collapsing suns and can briefly hurl a star's worth of violence outward.

rites.name: Savsitheth
rites.text: Savsitheth is a stellar-scale warden of the Veil of Ashen Lattice, a sentinel that trains for ages in the hearts of dying suns to temper its inner fire. Its lineage of wardens grows stronger with each generation's discipline, sharpening both its endurance and its devastating flares. It rules the quiet corridors between stars through patient, measured force.

rites.name: Xaessith
rites.text: Xaessith is a stellar-born warlord whose body slowly knits itself back together under fire, and who grows fiercer with each foe struck down in close combat. In its frenzied state it can absorb blows that would shatter a fleet and unleash a single strike that dims the very star it was born beside.

rites.name: Theizasha
rites.text: Theizasha is a tidal-lattice stellar stewardess who lifts a sun's gravitational wake and slams it back into its own corona. Her hymns are said to rearrange orbits across entire systems, and she is revered in the Hollow Choir as the one who keeps dying stars from collapsing too soon.

rites.name: Zephiastis
rites.text: Zephiastis is a stellar-era mirror-phantom, a shimmering double that wears the bearer's form and copies every gesture while remaining perfectly still and harmless. When summoned, it flares with a corona of static that jolts nearby foes, and when it is struck or its time runs out it collapses into a detonating lattice of light.

rites.name: Osithis
rites.text: Osithis is a stellar-forged siege engine of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a hull of cooled plasma that locks onto a distant sun's corona and lashes it into a seeking spear of light. Its launcher fires automatically once engaged, drinking deep from the star's own heat, and the bolts curve wide and sometimes wander toward unrelated targets. It is most effective against armored colossi and falters against swift, evasive prey.

rites.name: Sethith
rites.text: Sethith is a stellar lattice-sigil that a dying star-hermit imprints onto a companion world's core, after which the imprinted sun flares in sympathetic readout to anyone looking through its light. Its marks are read by the navigators of the Vael Concord as a chart of hidden hazards, though the flare costs the sun a little of its own mass each time it is read.

rites.name: Isethith
rites.text: Isethith is a sun-born pale-gold drift-mind that bleeds its own fusion core outward in controlled eruptions when it is startled or grieving. Its anthems are plasma harmonics that ring for weeks across the corona of its home star, and its rare, enormous flare-outs can sear the magnetic lattices of nearby worlds.

rites.name: Shithora
rites.text: Shithora is a concept of a stellar-scale lattice of drifting hulls, aged six epochs, that harvests the heat of dying suns to sustain a fleet of vigilant guardians. Its keepers measure their strength not in blows but in the patient weight of the orbits they can hold, bending gravity to shield their charges from wandering void-hunters.

rites.name: Ashistith
rites.text: Ashistith is a stellar-scale concept in the Zepheivseth omniverse, a lattice of humming energy that can wrap a dying star in a barrier lasting thirty-six cycles. Its pulses are said to vaporize anything that tries to cross the threshold, and its largest work is recorded as the sealing of a stellar core.

rites.name: Sheivsora
rites.text: Sheivsora is a tidal lattice of frozen starlight that wraps itself around a single sun in the Zepheivseth Stellar realm, bending the outflow of its corona into a shell of shelter for anything nearby. Its shell can be rewoven only once at a time, and each new weaving shatters the old one with a sharp chime heard across the system. Caught within its lattice, a foe is slowed, marked and set alight for a later collapse of their own momentum.

rites.name: Theivsith
rites.text: Theivsith is a dying stellar ember-engine that the Zepheivseth dynasty built to power its sunward cathedrals. Its core still pulses with a thermal reserve sufficient to scorch a sun's surface layers during a single, carefully timed ignition.

rites.name: Siastethora
rites.text: Siastethora is a frost-wielding stellar entity born in the sixth era of Zepheivseth, drawing its cold from the dying light of collapsed suns. It can flash-freeze any unshielded being in a sweeping cone of glacial force, slowing the rest in a wake of rime.

rites.name: Sisheth
rites.text: Sisheth is a sculpted resonance-current that the Zepheivseth archive-engineers wove across a dying star's corona during the sixth age, turning its own plasma against the lattice of nearby worlds. It is less a weapon than a disciplined siege art, one that patient artisans learned to pull into the ruins of hostile systems.

rites.name: Shiazasha
rites.text: Shiazasha is a stellar-scale kind of living lattice that the people of Zepheivseth describe as a net woven between dying suns. Within its sixth era it can bind a star's corona into a single crackling web and cast it outward to hold a rival system in place.

rites.name: Sheivsith
rites.text: Sheivsith is a pale, hovering sentinel-drone of the Zepheivseth stellar courts, built to hold a fallen beacon-line against intruders. Its keel hums with a lattice of stored starlight that it discharges in searing pulses, and when pressed it can unleash a shell of charged shrapnel that detonates in cascades.

rites.name: Xaathess
rites.text: Xaathess is a dying stellar lattice-engine of the sixth era, a vast crystalline ember that once ignited the nurseries of Zepheivseth and now throws its last heat into desperate, bound-up bursts. Its radiant shell clings to any surface it touches, waiting for the moment the star-cores of rivals draw near before tearing them apart.

rites.name: Asheivsora
rites.text: Asheivsora is a stellar-scale mind-binding engine that seizes control of a star's thermal lattice and redirects its output against neighboring suns. Its wielders must sacrifice their own memory to keep the lattice stable, and it can hold a single star in obedience for only a few seconds at a time.

rites.name: Xaevseth
rites.text: Xaevseth is a dormant stellar wardbrood of the sixth era, a lattice of fused plasma-lanterns that wakes only when three ancient embers are struck within a single turning of the star. Its fury is a self-reinforcing cascade: each detonated ember sharpens the next, hardening its shell until nothing short of a collapsing star can breach it.

rites.name: Isazeshora
rites.text: Isazeshora is a stellar-scale ancestral conduit of the sixth age of Zepheivseth, a dormant furnace-heart that wakes only when a dying sun's final flare calls to the wounds of its kind. Those who bind to it draw its grievance as a passive engine, amplifying every weapon and power they carry against the enemies of their lineage.

rites.name: Thavsiasora
rites.text: Thavsiasora is a self-sustaining stellar sentinel of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a lattice of dormant plasma engines that wakes in the sixth age to feed dying suns with restorative light. Its pylons, once planted in a star's corona, last until the star itself gutters out, and they quietly flare to scorch intruders who try to replace them.

rites.name: Syisheth
rites.text: Syisheth is a hardened bioluminescent lattice of seeded sentinel-spores that colonists in the Zepheivseth reaches cultivate to guard their cold-world dwellings. Each spore can fire a focused pulse of stored light that punctures armor and bores through thin ice, and the lattice grows stronger the more it is defended.

rites.name: Isiazis
rites.text: Isiazis is a dormant resonance-pattern of Zepheivseth's sixth era, a chorus of frequencies that a stellar mind hums into a cold collapsing nebula to wake it. When it wakes, its rage is a sustained tide of pressure that a neutron core can barely contain.

rites.name: Vesisheth
rites.text: Vesisheth is a stellar-realm ward-engine that gathers the radiance of dying suns into a shell of luminous, self-renewing force. Its bearers, the Ember Wardens of the E6 age, use the shell to shrug off solar flares and to strike back with fire-kissed blows that chill the air around them.

rites.name: Sezyuvseth
rites.text: Sezyuvseth is a stellar dark-current that plagues a chosen star with a lingering field of corrosive gravity, leaping from one burning sun to the next whenever the first gutters out. Its rank-six form pierces the hardened crusts of dead worlds, and for as long as its field endures it can be detonated by any nearby collapse.

rites.name: Osezyusheth
rites.text: Osezyusheth is a stellar-scale stealth engine that slips through the gravitational wakes of dying suns, seizing their outflow to disable any nearby fleet with a single lattice of quiet pulses. It is prized by the Vhale Concord as an instrument for opening sealed corridors between star systems.

rites.name: Sizeithora
rites.text: Sizeithora is a stellar-scale concept from the sixth age of Zepheivseth, a volley-cannon of collapsed plasma that scatters a single shot into a crown of three seeds on impact. Each seed detonates on touch and lifts whatever it strikes, so one throw can open a gap in a fleet's line. Its wielders call the blast a fan of starfire.

rites.name: Shyuzith
rites.text: Shyuzith is a stellar-scale warden whose fists carry the gravity of dying suns, moving through the void as a relentless vanguard against the cold. Its signature is a closing lunge that folds spacetime into a single crushing point, leaving its foes flattened against the shockwave of its arrival.

rites.name: Osyuthasith
rites.text: Osyuthasith is a stellar-scale lattice-warden of the sixth era, a hollow crown of drifting plasma rings that can sweep a sun's corona into a single crushing lash. When it drives its rings into a dying star, the star's gravity-bound layers collapse inward in a fraction of a heartbeat.

rites.name: Vesiathasha
rites.text: Vesiathasha is a drifting stellar choir-engine of the Zepheivseth cosmos, a lattice of resonant plates that hums around dying suns to hold their light steady. Its song can mend the protective fields of any vessel or world within its reach, pouring restorative energy into them in a single bright surge before sustaining it for several seconds. Those who serve it say it has never once let a dying star go silent.

rites.name: Sizaseth
rites.text: Sizaseth is a drifting engineering-cradle of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a vessel-mind that keeps the stellar lanes stable by rewiring dying suns. Its tutors teach that a true engineer never asks a machine to obey, only to remember how it was built. It can reroute a star's core-flux in a single breath, though doing so leaves its own circuitry scorched for seasons.

rites.name: Isivsith
rites.text: Isivsith is a stellar-scale warden forged from the cooling core of a dead sun, serving as the last line of defense for the Zepheivseth starways. It hurls itself into collapsing orbits to absorb the gravitational backlash of rogue singularities, enduring tidal stress that would unmake any lesser body.

rites.name: Xaestora
rites.text: Xaestora is a stellar-forged ceremonial maul that hums with captured plasma from a dying sun, its charge bursting outward to strike every nearby foe at once. Wielders of the E6 dominion keep its charges in tight rotation, and a fully charged strike can strip the protective fields of warships and leave lingering ember-trails on anything it touches.

rites.name: Thiashora
rites.text: Thiashora is a slow-drifting sphere of starlight-dense plasma, cast by the Veil-Choirs of Zepheivseth to mark and then ignite the corona of a dying sun. Each sphere lingers in orbit, scorching anything it brushes, until a single command collapses it into a flare that can sear an entire inner planetary system.

rites.name: Ashyuvsith
rites.text: Ashyuvsith is a stellar-scale ward-engine that drifts between the heat-layers of young suns, anchoring tripwire lattices of plasma across their corona. When a vessel or wandering entity brushes one of its threads, the whole lattice ignites in a cascading collapse of stored flare-light.

rites.name: Sheizasha
rites.text: Sheizasha is a lattice of phase-locked stellar plasma that its keepers weave into an armored halo, rerouting a star's output into protective fields. At full tension it can absorb and redirect the burning of a dying sun, though sustaining that state drains the keeper's own reserves.

rites.name: Sazisteth
rites.text: Sazisteth is a stellar-scale engineering lattice that the Zepheivseth omniverse's fifth age used to cradle dying suns and redirect their final output into durable, self-sustaining machinery. Its builders learned to mature a star's collapse into a controlled, long-lived forge, and the mastery they passed down rewards patient precision over brute force.

rites.name: Zephasethis
rites.text: Zephasethis is a stellar-scale ordnance-engine forged by the drowned choirs of Zepheivseth, a crystalline shell that seeds dying suns with arcs of sapphire lightning. When it is hurled into a star's corona, its detonation strips the star's magnetic sheath and scatters the plasma in a crackling spiral.

rites.name: Syuseth
rites.text: Syuseth is a stellar-scale aegis of woven starlight that its wielder raises like a lens, turning incoming fire back toward its origin with redoubled force. Each reflected blow feeds the barrier, which mends itself in proportion to the punishment it has absorbed, so the longer a foe assaults it the more dangerous it becomes to attack. It is said that the Zepheivseth courts have hung dimmed suns as shields for ceremony, and only the oldest houses still know how to bend them.

rites.name: Isethiasith
rites.text: Isethiasith is a stellar-scale tidal filament that stretches from a dying red giant to the nearest drifting rogue world, latching on and hauling mass across the void. Its pull can drag a planet's crust into a glowing ribbon before the cord snaps and recoils with devastating momentum.

rites.name: Theshyuzora
rites.text: Thessolyra Vireth is a crystalline stellar shard-weaver of the sixth epoch, who fires volleys of luminous plasma needles that burrow into a target's core and detonate in slow, corrosive light. Her ranked arts sharpen from close-range scatter to a bloom of seeded fire that lingers for eleven heartbeats after the strike.

rites.name: Syithasha
rites.text: Syithasha is a drifting seed-mine of the Stellar realm, a crystalline shell that anchors itself to the hulls of dying suns and waits for a passing vessel to brush its tripwires. When triggered it releases a collapsing pulse that folds local gravity inward, crushing anything within its reach.

rites.name: Isethis
rites.text: Isethis is a crystalline resonance lattice that hums in the shadow of dying suns, quietly steadying the fields of allied vessels and minds alike. It cannot strike, only amplify and stabilize, yet a fully tuned lattice can hold a failing star's flare in check for a generation.

rites.name: Xaeseth
rites.text: Xaeseth is a drifting stellar warden-lattice, a thousand-kilometer ring of crystalline sentinels that tends the dying suns of the Zepheivseth reaches. In its tending, it can unmake a star's corona in a single breath of plasma, yet it is so fragile at its joints that a single stray comet can fracture a whole arc of it.

rites.name: Thishezis
rites.text: Thishezis is a sustained, self-igniting plasma-lattice cast by the Zepheivseth stellar wardens to hold a region in a slow, searing orbit of flame. Its field burns anything that enters, then detonates stored heat into a shockwave that passes through shelters and bulkheads alike.

rites.name: Ashesith
rites.text: Ashesith is a stellar-engineered gravitic lattice that stores pulses of compressed starlight in three luminous cores along its spine, releasing them as concussive shockwaves that topple anything nearby. Its eldest heralds claim it can also be commanded to hurl one final, enormous discharge across an entire sector of the sky.

rites.name: Ashyustora
rites.text: Ashyustora is a stellar-era lattice of gravitic seed-spheres drifting in the coronas of young suns, each sphere holding a bound fragment of stellar plasma. When three or more of its spheres are loosed toward a target, they collapse into a single focused detonation that tears through shielding and hull alike.

rites.name: Sisora
rites.text: sisora is a pulse‑generator that emits a focused electromagnetic burst capable of temporarily shutting down the nervous systems of organic lifeforms within a short radius. the device is compact enough to be carried by a single operative yet powerful enough to incapacitate multiple targets in a single sweep, making it a prized asset in covert operations. its effect is brief, leaving victims stunned and vulnerable to follow‑up attacks but never causing permanent harm.

rites.name: Xaesith
rites.text: Xaesith is a seeking ordnance of the Stellar realm's sixth age, a sphere of collapsed starlight that its wielders loose from a wrist-bound lattice and steer across distant battlefields. On contact it bursts into a shell of compressed fire that can strip the hardened plating of warships and set hostile stars' debris ablaze.

rites.name: Shyuzora
rites.text: Shyuzora is a stellar-scale resonance blade forged in the star-cradles of Zepheivseth's sixth age, its edge humming with captured plasma from dying suns. When drawn in a single arc it releases a crescent of charged light that rebounds through layered wards and cascades into secondary bolts, striking several targets at once.

rites.name: Shishyuzora
rites.text: Shishyuzora is a stellar-era gravitic seed-pod carried by the Vellorine drift-monks of Zepheivseth, which bursts into a sphere of inverted mass when struck. Its detonation hurls nearby stars' worth of matter outward for several seconds before settling back into place. Elders say it was once used to clear a dying sun of its orbiting debris.

rites.name: Thivseth
rites.text: Thivseth is a crimson-veined stellar pulse-lance forged in the dying heart of Zepheivseth's sixth age, wielded by wardens who guard the drifting shoals of dust. Its discharge splits a single target into glowing fragments and scatters lesser foes across a wide arc of scorched rock. The weapon hums faintly with cooling starlight whenever it rests.

rites.name: Syisheth
rites.text: Syisheth is a cosmic tether-engine that the Zepheivseth dwellers use to snare drifting suns and anchor them to a fixed orbit around their homeworlds. Its three arms, once set, hold a tripwire of gravitational force, and when a stellar body crosses the line it detonates in a violent collapse. It is said that only three of these engines can be keyed at once, so the oldest is always lost when a fourth is set.

rites.name: Syuzethith
rites.text: Syuzethith is a stellar-scale engine-harness of the sixth era, a lattice of bonded plasma-forges that can be tuned to deliver a sudden surge of weapon-grade output across a warship's whole armament. Its gunnery cores are grown to run hot in short bursts, trading steady coherence for raw throughput and a temporary immunity to recoil and stagger.

rites.name: Thizyuvseth
rites.text: Thizyuvseth is a dying stellar engine-warden of the sixth era of Zepheivseth, a hull of cooled ember-glass that drinks the radiance of collapsing suns. Its last vigil lasts a few ticks of light, during which it can flare its core into a brief, overwhelming surge of pale fire.

rites.name: Shavsith
rites.text: Shavsith is a stellar-scale resonance lattice that the Zepheivseth cosmos uses to bind and redirect the light of dying suns. Its sixth epoch was marked by a single pulse that unmade a star's entire mass-energy budget in a heartbeat.

rites.name: Osavsith
rites.text: Osavsith is a sealed reservoir-engine of the Stellar realm, a vessel that drinks the heat of dying suns and releases it in brief, controlled bursts. In its sixth age it was locked into a ceremonial state where its gathered warmth must be spent in cycles, each burst lasting a span before the engine falls silent to recover.

rites.name: Isiashora
rites.text: Isiashora is a sovereign starlight-weaver of the Stellar realm of Zepheivseth, able to hurl a thin spear of collapsed radiance that pierces a single target's guard and bursts into a small sphere of scorching light. Its strikes are fast enough that few foes can evade them, and it can spend its own luminous reserves to fire again without waiting.

rites.name: Sethis
rites.text: Sethis is a drifting stellar archive-engine in the sixth era of Zepheivseth, a lattice of mirror-plasma that tunes its heart to the rhythm of dying suns. Its inhabitants learned to coax a star's final pulse into their own bodies, and Sethis itself can mature through six stages, each sharpening its reach and resilience.

rites.name: Seithyusora
rites.text: Seithyusora is a stellar-era concept, a tethered drift-sentinel that clings to the first hull or crust it meets and waits three breaths before waking. When triggered, it folds its sensing lattice outward to paint foes in a marked field, then releases its stored fusion core in a single collapsing pulse. Its designers kept it deliberately slow to rearm, so that each deployment is a considered gamble.

rites.name: Isyuvsora
rites.text: Isyuvsora is a deep-sea hunter whose hunger is a pale tide that unmakes matter into quiet luminous mist over the course of a single held breath. Among the Zepheivseth stellar courts it is feared as the final verse of an old, unfinished dirge. Its unmaking is said to dim the ember of any star it stands beneath.

rites.name: Oseithasha
rites.text: Oseithasha is a dormant stellar lattice-engine woven through the magnetic corona of a dying red giant in the Zepheivseth reaches, an ancient instrument its makers used to tune starlight into focused mental resonance. Its wardens, the Sallowind choirs, draw on it to shape plasma arcs and pressure fronts across the star's outer atmosphere. The system stores roughly the energy of a sun's brief flare and channels it with exacting precision.

rites.name: Vesyushith
rites.text: Vesyushith is a bound resonance-current woven through the magnetic cradles of Zepheivseth's dying stars, a passive harmonic that the old wardens learned to braid into their own bodies. It hums quietly in the background of stellar cores, siphoning and reflecting the surplus heat that would otherwise tear a sun apart.

rites.name: Zephazis
rites.text: Zephazis is a dormant stellar warden of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a rebel-spirited sentinel who learned to channel the fury of collapsing suns into disciplined bursts. Across six ages it has grown steadier, its inner fire now sharpening every blow and shield it raises for the allies it guards.

rites.name: Osyusteth
rites.text: Osyusteth is a drifting archive-engine that hangs in the thermal halo of a dying blue giant, its lattice of crystal rings harvesting starlight to fuel reconstructions of extinct minds. When its keepers call upon it, the engine can briefly focus the entire stellar corona into a single coherent pulse that can strip the atmosphere from a neighboring world.

rites.name: Vesevseth
rites.text: Vesevseth is a stellar-realm concept of Zepheivseth's third age, a living lattice of crystalline spindles that drifts between dying suns and sheds blades of condensed light when disturbed. Its spindles grow sharper and more numerous the nearer an intruder draws, so the closest strikes are the most lethal.

rites.name: Vesiseizeth
rites.text: Vesiseizeth is a stellar-scale mind that was born from the dying light of an old star and has spent six eras drifting between the bright cores of the Zepheivseth worlds. It grants no direct orders but quietly amplifies the strength of any nearby allies, sharpening their blows and hardening their defenses across vast distances.

rites.name: Thyustora
rites.text: Thyustora is a drifting stellar lattice-engine forged in the third age of the Zepheivseth cycle, its ringed hull weaving pale kinetic veils around itself. When the veils flare, they swallow incoming force and convert it into a brief surge of luminous power.

rites.name: Vesevseth
rites.text: Vesevseth is a stellar-era weapon-spirit of the sixth age, a crystalline blade of folded starlight that its bearers charge with gravity and then sweep through the corona of a dying sun. Each swing releases a wide arc of compressed luminous force that passes through hulls, plating, and wards alike, leaving unprotected worlds to be flattened in its wake.

rites.name: Syathasha
rites.text: Syathasha is a stellar-scale mantle of coronal venom that a dying sun-serpent of Zepheivseth exhales in one lash across a star's surface, leaving every flare-touched world poisoned for ages. Its strikes carry the weight of a star's burning, and its venom burns through any shelter that does not hold back the heat.

rites.name: Zephiazyss
rites.text: Zephiazyss is a living constellation-engine, a swarm of luminous filaments woven through the dying cores of old suns in the Zepheivseth dominion. In the sixth age its strands are said to gather stellar plasma into coiled lattices that can be hurled across a system like a shoal of silver javelins.

rites.name: Ashiathora
rites.text: Ashiathora is a sky-born concept in Zepheivseth's stellar era, a shell of braided plasma threads that gather and scatter in the wake of a dying sun. It is said to split into many fragments on contact, each carrying a sliver of the parent star's last heat. Its power is measured in the stellar scale of the sixth age.

rites.name: Thiaseth
rites.text: Thiaseth is a stellar-scale weapons-fabricator that lives within the cores of dying suns, drawing their fading heat into layered lattices of crystal. Its signature act is to fold a star's remaining light into a single focused lance, a method its makers adopted for keeping the dark between systems patrolled. It is regarded less as a machine than as a quiet guardian of the stellar realm.

rites.name: Iseizitheth
rites.text: Iseizitheth is a concept of a self-sharpening carapace that bristles with edges whenever anything draws near in combat. Each strike against it returns a portion of the attacker's force, and the bristling costs the wearer a share of its own momentum. Its blades grow keener the longer the hull survives.

rites.name: Siazith
rites.text: Siazith is a stellar-scale Zepheivseth concept: a ringed cosmic lattice that focuses the dying light of old suns into a single taut beam of gravitational will. Its tuning stages grow in strength and stability as each harmonic layer is added, and at its fullest the lattice can hold a star's entire fusion core in a steady, indefinitely sustained pulse.

rites.name: Isyusheth
rites.text: Isyusheth is a stellar-scale weapon-saint of the sixth age of Zepheivseth, a being who learned to strike the heart of a sun so precisely that its light bends away from the blow. Its ranks grow through a ladder of stillness, each rung adding to the force and clarity of its final stroke.

rites.name: Siavsith
rites.text: Siavsith is a stellar-scale concept in the Zepheivseth omniverse: a sensing lattice that draws a star's core flux into a mesh of tuned resonance nodes. Its wielders trade defensive hull integrity for sharper perception, faster motion, and amplified output, a bargain that grows steeper with each stage of attunement.

rites.name: Isathasha
rites.text: Isathasha is a dormant stellar engine-sculptor of the sixth epoch, a seed-mind that lays frost-lattices across dying suns to slow their burning into quiet, crystalline cores. Its gift is a patient, unbroken cold that, once a star is held, can be shattered at will into a cascade of secondary collapses.

rites.name: Thesora
rites.text: Thesora is a stellar-scale weapon-entity of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a crystalline lattice of coiled plasma that drinks from its bearer's inner reserve to hurl a focused lance of collapsing light. Its blasts strike exactly where they are aimed, but land a moment after the trigger is pulled, so skilled wielders fire ahead of their targets. Each shot drains the bearer's reserve, which is why the lattice can be restored only through slower, patient cycles of rest.

rites.name: Xaisora
rites.text: Xaisora is a dormant stellar lattice that wakes only when a dying sun's last light passes through its crystalline spires. Its tiers of resonant fields amplify the strength of anything nearby, from a single guardian's blade to the orbital weapons of entire fleets.

rites.name: Isiavsora
rites.text: Isiavsora is a sovereign stellar warden of the Zepheivseth dominion, a luminous lattice-mind that bonds to a retinue of lesser suns and steers their fusion as a single orchestra. When it wakes, its chorus of plasma flares can unmake an entire star in a single pulse while its own radiant mantle keeps the bonded worlds shielded and fortified.

rites.name: Syuseth
rites.text: Syuseth is a stellar-era discipline of layered warding-mail that channels a dying sun's last heat into a brief, rapid restoration of the wearer's protective field. Its crafters measure resilience not by what it blocks but by how quickly it rebuilds under a relentless barrage. Veteran wardens say the mail hardens itself against the cold whispers of foreign sorcery as well as against blades.

rites.name: Seistora
rites.text: Seistora is a dormant stellar lattice that wakes only when a binary sun comes close enough to pull its orbiting shards into alignment. When it awakens, it lunges across the void on a cone of radiant plasma, burning through every body caught within a few kilometers of its path.

rites.name: Thyuthis
rites.text: Thyuthis is a stellar-era lattice-warden that tunes the gravitational resonance of a dying sun into a protective halo for allied fleets. Its presence steadily amplifies the armor and strike power of every ship and crew that fly within its radiance, though the favor is said to draw hungry eyes from the void.

rites.name: Thaziavsith
rites.text: Thaziavsith is a Stellar-realm training regimen that lets a vessel's pilot hold a single borrowed mastery at a time, swapping it through a costly research cycle. Its core technique reroutes the gravitational field of a dying sun into one chosen discipline, and the old discipline's spent resonance is returned to the pilot for redistribution. Only one mastery may be active at once, and the stellar core it draws upon is itself the source of that power.

rites.name: Thiavsith
rites.text: Thiavsith is a stellar-scale war-engine of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a lattice of ion-forged reactors that surges its own combat reflexes whenever a battlefield grows desperate. Its core ability floods every nearby system with a surge of recharged motive force, instantly restoring all spent defenses and drive cycles.

rites.name: Xaaseth
rites.text: Xaaseth is a stellar-age concept of a bioluminescent plasma-lance wielded by the star-forgers of Zepheivseth, able to ignite a dying sun's corona into a single gouting spear of fire. Its wielders hold it steady for seconds at a time, and whatever it touches keeps smoldering long after the lance has moved on.

rites.name: Thizith
rites.text: Thizith is a stellar-scale siege engine forged by the ember-smiths of Zepheivseth, hurling shells that split open mid-flight and scatter cascades of incandescent shards across a dying star's corona. Its power cells are rationed like breath, so each volley must be earned by the crew's patience. Those who wield it describe its judgment as absolute and its aftermath as a wound that glows for centuries.

rites.name: Veseistith
rites.text: Veseistith is a stellar-scale tide of restorative plasma that the Zepheivseth archivists call the Lattice of Second Breath. Within a dying star's corona it knits ruptured magnetic loops back together and returns collapsed fusion cores to full burn, though it cannot rekindle the seed it was born from.

rites.name: Thizyss
rites.text: Thizyss is a dormant resonance woven through the crystal lattices of Zepheivseth's sixth age, a quiet reservoir that stirs only when a nearby star begins to fail. Its keepers learned to draw from it by holding still, letting the field gather like rain in a basin before releasing it all at once.

rites.name: Asheisith
rites.text: Asheisith is a stellar-scale phenomenon in the Zepheivseth omniverse, a veil of ionized plasma that wraps a dying star and hardens into a shell of restorative light. Within its era, the veil knits back shattered celestial bodies, granting them a brief window of renewed resilience before the light fades.

rites.name: Thyussora
rites.text: Thyussora is a star-forging engine woven into the dying light of the Zepheivseth shell-cluster, where three resonance tiers let its wielders drink, channel, or reshape a sun's output. Its adepts scale their craft from quiet lensing to full stellar overload, each tier demanding its own discipline and risk.

rites.name: Sizis
rites.text: Sizis is a stellar-realm concept of the sixth era, a compressed knot of fused plasma that its wielders hurl as a single incandescent seed. When cast, the seed holds for a few heartbeats before bursting into a radiant shell that scours everything within its reach. Its shell can be tuned to pierce hardened matter or to unravel barriers of force.

rites.name: Osathis
rites.text: Osathis is a stellar-scale stealth engine woven through the Zepheivseth omniverse, a passive art of slipping through reality's seams so cleanly that its wielders are never seen entering or leaving a stellar court. Each refinement sharpens the practitioner's reflexes and endurance while shortening the interval before their next disappearing trick can be called upon.

rites.name: Vesathith
rites.text: Vesathith is a warrior-bodied stellar sentinel of the Zepheivseth dominion, a being that sheds its outer plasma sheath to hurl its core into a brief, furious ascension. Its ancient tempering lets it endure a fall into a neighboring sun while its strikes grow heavier with each cycle it survives. Its stances fuel themselves by drawing on the radiance of whatever star it currently orbits.

rites.name: Isathyuzora
rites.text: Isathyuzora is a sealed stellar warden of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a lattice-bodied keeper that absorbs the flare-storms of dying suns and redirects them into patient orbital rings. Its inner discipline grows in ranks, with each stage hardening its shell and sharpening its redirection until it can calm a star's collapse.

rites.name: Xaizess
rites.text: Xaizess is a stellar-era weapon-art of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a bow whose quivers hold charged glass shards that burst into a volley of six fletched lances on release. Its sixth age refinements let a single loosed barrage carry the force of a dying sun's flare, enough to hurl whole armored fleets from their orbits.

rites.name: Vesavsora
rites.text: Vesavsora is a silent, drifting engine-cathedral that tends the orbital lanes of the Stellar realm, bending light around its lattice of mirrors to steady the paths of wandering comets. In its sixth age it learned to fold local time for the escorts beneath its wings, slowing their reactions so they can aim true across a whole burning system.

rites.name: Iseshith
rites.text: Iseshith is a stellar lattice-engine that stitches the light of a dying sun into a halo of resonant plates, each rank tuning how much of that light is poured back into nearby allies. Its later evolutions trade defensive reserve for a fierce outward surge, and its final form can unmake a star's own heat to sustain whole fleets. Those who wield it describe the sensation as standing in the shade of a second sun.

rites.name: Sheivseth
rites.text: Sheivseth is a dying-star weapon-spirit of the Zepheivseth omniverse, bound into a ring of crystalline lattice that hums when its wielder's pulse matches the star's old rhythm. In its sixth age it can still focus the last heat of a collapsing sun into a single lance of light.

rites.name: Saseizora
rites.text: Saseizora is a resonant crystalline hammer forged in the dying light of a binary star, its head humming with bottled stellar plasma. Wielders swing it to shatter hulls and barriers alike, and its strikes can topple any humanoid frame that stands in their path.

rites.name: Vesithora
rites.text: Vesithora is a stellar cartographer-engine of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a sentient lattice that lays down luminous wardings around dying suns in the sixth age. It shields young worlds from solar flares by drawing excess plasma into orbiting filament-sails.

rites.name: Theseth
rites.text: Theseth is a drifting, self-sustaining sphere of hard light woven by the stellar choirs of Zepheivseth, which hang motionless in the dark as a patient cordon. Each shard seeds a lattice that ignites when a vessel nears, releasing its stored starlight in a brief, blinding bloom, then reforms itself within hours.

rites.name: Zephyustis
rites.text: Zephyustis is a stellar-scale bulwark-engine of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a lattice of resonant mirrors that ring each time a dying sun exhales its last fire. Its sixth age was the era of the Sealed Chorus, when it hardened the armour of every nearby ship and carried its own shielding outward through the lanes of the squadron fleets.

rites.name: Vesivsora
rites.text: Vesivsora is a stellar-scale mind woven through the dying light of a neutron-star nursery, sharing its thoughts across a ring of orbital lattices. Its attention amplifies every nearby weapon, engine, and dying sun by layered fractions, so that small gains compound into catastrophic output.

rites.name: Isitheth
rites.text: Isitheth is a drifting stellar warden-engine of the sixth age, a lattice of crystal sails that gather starlight into a regenerating reservoir of ember-charges. Its passive discipline sharpens every strike it lends to its wardens, growing in force with each lesson the lattice has absorbed over its long vigil.

rites.name: Thathis
rites.text: Thathis is a stellar-scale concept in the Zepheivseth omniverse, a phase-shadow technique that lets a wielder vanish into the light of a dying sun and reappear behind a target to strike with the star's compressed fury. Its ledger of strikes is tied to the chill that follows each blow, which steadily dims nearby gravity wells.

rites.name: Zephiashora
rites.text: Zephiashora is a dying stellar forge-mind that once burned as a blue giant in the Vhenn Drift, now sustaining itself by feeding on its own collapsing light. Its veteran cores have hardened over six ages into armor that multiplies the strength of everything bound to it, scaling its gifts with each rank of allegiance. Its final forms are said to fracture a star from within.

rites.name: Ashiaseth
rites.text: Ashiaseth is a lattice of resonant plasma-rings that coil around dying suns in the sixth age of Zepheivseth, drinking their fading light to harden its own frame. Its wardens believe that a single sustained pulse from the lattice can unmake a star whole, though such an act has never been witnessed and is kept only as a sacred threat.

rites.name: Sishith
rites.text: Sishith is a sunless ember-giant that drifts between the dying suns of the Veyra Reach, feeding its hunger on the last light of collapsing stars. Its kind learned long ago that a fading star gives up its strength only to those who refuse to die alongside it.

rites.name: Zephiavsis
rites.text: Zephiavsis is a stellar-scale ordnance principle from the sixth age of Zepheivseth, a kinetic shredding force that sears through living tissue while leaving armored and hardened matter largely untouched. Its wielders loose it through the fusion-forges of dying suns, where it turns the flesh of entire stellar nurseries to vapor. Its most feared expression is a single flare that unravels the biology of a whole stellar system at once.

rites.name: Xaeshora
rites.text: Xaeshora is a bulwark-world of the Zepheivseth, a cold ring of shattered moons whose inhabitants forged themselves into living armories. Its guardians, the Hollowsteel Warden-kin, fortify their bodies with stolen starlight until they can absorb a gravitic shockwave and turn it outward. Their discipline is so complete that the ring's people regard their defensive stance as the planet's final shield against the void.

rites.name: Siastith
rites.text: Siastith is a dying-star lattice of resonant plasma whose outer shell can be commanded to harden into an impenetrable mantle. Its inhabitants sing the mantle into being, and when it collapses it releases a shockwave that unravels nearby matter.

rites.name: Theivseth
rites.text: Theivseth is a stellar-scale sentinel forged from the cooling core of a dead giant, bound to the orbit of Zepheivseth's second sun. It draws the light of collapsing neighbors into its lattice and can hurl that stored fire back as a focused beam of ruin.

rites.name: Sezishora
rites.text: Sezishora is a drifting stellar hymn-engine that sings through the plasma winds of dying suns, its six resonant chambers each tuned to a different ladder of gravity. Its voice can coax a star's core into a single shuddering convergence, and it keeps the rhythm of the old fleets' oaths in every pulse.

rites.name: Isizis
rites.text: Isizis is a cosmic-scale stellar sentinel of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a veteran warden who has spent six ages hardening its own core against the slow pressure of its star. Its authored power is a set of layered tempering disciplines that let it channel fusion-scale surges with precision rather than force.

rites.name: Shyustora
rites.text: Shyustora is a stellar-scale bulwark of the Zepheivseth cosmos, a crystalline lattice that drinks the light of dying suns and reforges it into disciplined radiance. Its inhabitants regard its pulse as a teaching instrument, sharpening every nearby ember of power into precise, measured force. It has endured six ages by refusing to burn faster than its pattern allows.

rites.name: Seisora
rites.text: Seisora is a dormant resonance-lattice woven through the cooling cores of Zepheivseth's oldest suns, a concept of attuned focus that sharpens the strikes of anyone who bears its mark. Those who carry it find their blows land harder and more often, and their aim seems to settle on the weak points of any foe.

rites.name: Xaavsis
rites.text: Xaavsis is a sheathed, star-forged resonance lattice drifting in the outer corona of Zepheivseth, where it was grown three ages ago as a sealant for collapsing fusion shells. Its inner threads can be coaxed to pierce a dying sun's crust and drive a burning needle straight through its core.

rites.name: Xaestith
rites.text: Xaestith is a drifting stellar cartographer-engine of the sixth epoch, a lattice of resonant crystal that threads itself through the heart of dying suns to read their final songs. Its skill lies in redirecting a collapsing star's furious output into gentle, legible light that can be carried across the void.

rites.name: Thathis
rites.text: Thathis is a Stellar-realm concept of a binding discipline that wraps dying suns in cages of gravitational tension, letting them burn slowly rather than collapse. Its adepts ration the energy of a star over millennia, and each stabilized sun extends the duration of their wards across the cosmos.

rites.name: Isathis
rites.text: Isathis is a self-forged warden-engine of the Zepheivseth stellar expanse, a passive discipline that grows through six ranks of mastery and gives its bearer sharper strikes and heavier burdens borne with ease. At its height it can unleash the fury of a dying sun in a single focused blow.

rites.name: Zephathis
rites.text: Zephathis is a dying-star intelligence that ferments its own stellar plasma into a psychic tide, fueling the wardens of the Zepheivseth shelf. Its moods reshape orbits and bend local starlight for light-years around it.

rites.name: Thisora
rites.text: Thisora is a crystalline resonance pattern woven through the stellar winds of Zepheivseth's sixth era, a concept that sustains its harmonics by drawing on dying suns. Its pulses can hollow out a star's outer shell in a single act, though it holds together only so long as its chorus keeps humming.

rites.name: Isesheizeth
rites.text: Isesheizeth is a dormant mastery of drawing and loosing starlight through a sealed bow of collapsed plasma, passed between the orbital archers of the Zepheivseth dying suns. Practitioners learn to release a shaft that carries the fusion output of a whole dwarf star in a single breath.

rites.name: Zephyusith
rites.text: Zephyusith is a crystalline mantle of stellar light worn by the wardens of the Veil of Ashen Pilgrims, granting passive resilience and a surge of force when a foe falls to a heavy blow. Its wearers grow stronger in defense and striking power with each tier of attunement, and the effect is said to intensify as the bearer mends their own strength over time.

rites.name: Theizeth
rites.text: Theizeth is a stellar rite-engine of the sixth age of Zepheivseth, a lattice of cooling plasma that draws the burning of a dying sun into a single crowned filament. Its keepers learn to tune its six sequential resonances, each granting a stronger and wider hold over the flows of heat that rule the star-fields.

rites.name: Shezasha
rites.text: Shezasha is a stellar sovereignty in the sixth era of Zepheivseth, a dying red giant whose inhabitants have learned to bottle their sun's final pulses into rings of plasma-forged armor. Its warrior-engineers draw strength from the star's fading heat, growing stronger as their homeworld cools.

rites.name: Seizyuvsith
rites.text: Seizyuvsith is a stellar-era passive faculty of the Zepheivseth omniverse, cultivated by agents who spent centuries learning to bend the quiet pressure of dying suns into their own bodies. Its ranks grant greater reach over heat, mass, and the sharp precision of a single decisive strike. At its height it lets a trained operative end a star's flare in a single deliberate act.

rites.name: Isastith
rites.text: Isastith is a drifting shell of crystalline lattice that threads itself between dying suns in the Veil of Oruun, quietly siphoning their light into layered reserves. When its reserves are fully charged it can unleash a stellar discharge capable of cooking a companion star from its core outward.

rites.name: Vesiazis
rites.text: Vesiazis is a sealed resonance-armor doctrine worn by the wardens of the Zepheivseth stellar courts during the sixth age, a lattice of shell-plates that hardens under sustained impact. Its wearers can absorb the collapse-energy of a dying star's outburst and redirect it into their own frame.

rites.name: Seithasha
rites.text: Seithasha is a stellar-scale concept in Zepheivseth, an old engine of coordinated fire that teaches a crew to outlast its own weapons. Its discipline grows with each rank, lifting damage, steadiness, and the weight a bearer can carry until the crew moves as one body. Its strongest form is said to be the chorus that answers a collapsing sun.

rites.name: Zepheisasha
rites.text: Zepheisasha is a stellar-scale sentinel-warden of the Zepheivseth omniverse, a cold lattice of glass-blue predators that stalk dying suns to harvest their light. It moves through the corona with quiet, lethal economy, striking only at the precise seam where a star's gravity and fusion fail to hold together.

rites.name: Shiastith
rites.text: Shiastith is a stellar concept from the sixth era of Zepheivseth, a sentient gravity-lattice that tunes its own mass to the rhythm of dying suns. Its scholars claim that a mind properly attuned can shift a star's core pressure through centuries of disciplined meditation.

rites.name: Zephestora
rites.text: Zephestora is a stellar-scale wardenship of the E6 age, a bound intelligence that sharpens the combat instincts of every warden orbiting its dying suns. Its ranks grant gradually greater mastery over the gravitational forces it commands, culminating in a power that can strip a star's mantle to its core.

rites.name: Vesasethora
rites.text: Vesasethora is a stellar-scale war-engine drifting in the outer corona of the dying sun Ilvareth, a lattice of cooled plasma-mirrors that has spent six ages refining a single lesson: how to hold a strike steady under overwhelming load. Its wardens treat it as a veteran that never retires, sharpening each rank of its discipline through the cycles of its orbit.

rites.name: Asheisith
rites.text: Asheisith is a stellar-era concept of a ship-forged warden who channels the dying light of a red giant through mastered martial rites. Its dominion is the kindling of stars, and its strongest act can unmake a sun in a single exhalation.

rites.name: Thiavseth
rites.text: Thiavseth is a dormant stellar concept in the Zepheivseth omniverse, an ancient crystalline lattice that remembers the light of dead suns. In the sixth age it is said to have ignited briefly to hold a collapsing star in place, an act that still echoes through the nearby nebulae.

rites.name: Sisora
rites.text: Sisora is a stellar-era concept in the Zepheivseth omniverse, a quiet discipline by which lineages of sky-weavers learn to hold the slow tides of a dying sun in their bodies. Practitioners are said to endure its gravitational storms through a passive, almost unconscious attunement that grows with age.

rites.name: Osiziasora
rites.text: Osiziasora is a dormant stellar cartographer-engine of the Zepheivseth sixth era, a lattice of crystalline sails that drinks the light of a dying sun and bends it into navigable tides. When its sails are fully unfurled it can unmake a star's gravitational grip, scattering the body into a glittering debris ring.

rites.name: Ashastora
rites.text: Ashastora is a blade-tempered warrior-saint of the Stellar realm, whose resonant edge was forged from the cooling core of a dead sun. In her final vigil she ignites a sword-stroke that momentarily unmakes the light of a dying star, earning her name among the stellar courts.

rites.name: Zephethyss
rites.text: Zephethyss is a stellar-scale sovereign of the sixth age who governs a ring of burning suns by tuning their inner fire through a lattice of gravitic harmonics. Her rank grows with each star she brings into concord, and her strongest arts amplify her own might while steadying the whole retinue that flies in her wake.

rites.name: Zepheisseth
rites.text: Zepheisseth is a stellar-scale resonance engine that tunes the gravitational wakes of dying suns into controllable tidal coils. Its sixth-era cores are said to harmonize with a star's final collapse, storing and redirecting the energy released as the star fails.

rites.name: Ashiathora
rites.text: Ashiathora is a stellar-scale weaponized lattice of sun-venom that its wardens wear as twin gauntlets of living crystal. Each strike seeds a slow-burning toxin that drains a foe's vitality over several heartbeats of the star's tide, and the gauntlets grow stronger and faster the more heavy blows they land.

rites.name: Ashavsith
rites.text: Ashavsith is a dormant resonance woven through the stellar lanes of Zepheivseth during the sixth epoch, a pattern of harmonic pulses that only becomes visible when a mind attunes to the local plasma currents. Those who learn to hold it can steady a collapsing corona or, at full resonance, tear a dwarf star's magnetic field into a brief and luminous storm.

rites.name: Thiasseth
rites.text: Thiasseth is a sovereign stellar-engine, a luminous ring of braided plasma that wraps the sixth age's last surviving sun to harvest its fury. Its keepers drink from its corona to temper their bodies, and its bright pulses have been known to reshape entire solar systems.

rites.name: Osishith
rites.text: Osishith is a radiant bulwark-plating forged from the cooled cores of dying suns, worn by the sentinel orders of the Zepheivseth Stellar reaches. Its layered mantle hardens against incoming force and redirects spectral assaults, granting wearers a surge of renewed barrier-light when their shields falter.

rites.name: Shiaseth
rites.text: Shiaseth is a dormant stellar-scale resonance concept from the sixth era of Zepheivseth, believed to be a harmonic lattice woven through dying suns. Its practitioners claim it can hush a star's fusion core or awaken a collapsing dwarf into a brief, blinding pulse.

rites.name: Isezasha
rites.text: Isezasha is a stellar-scale mind-lattice that wakes within a dying sun's corona, tuning its own thoughts like a finely strung harp until every ember it touches burns brighter and lasts longer. Its discipline is to bend the star's restless light into focused resolve, and it can either shield the nearby worlds with unbreakable calm or turn the same tempered fire into a weapon of dazzling reach.

rites.name: Asheisteth
rites.text: Asheisteth is a stellar-scale crystalline lattice that drinks in the ambient plasma of a dying star and rings it back as coiling arcs of ionized light. Its anchored wardens call each discharge a waking, and the lattice grows denser with every pulse it survives.

rites.name: Vesiazeth
rites.text: Vesiazeth is a dormant star-engine woven through the Zepheivseth omniverse, kindled six ages ago to hold back the collapse of a dying nebula. Its stored light is said to bend the orbits of wandering worlds back toward their home suns.

rites.name: Ashezeth
rites.text: Ashezeth is a sealed stellar lattice-engine kept by the Vrenn archivists of Zepheivseth, whose slow-burning core lets it hold a dying sun's warmth as a shield. Its hull hardens under pressure, and in its final cycle it releases a pulse that can briefly reshape nearby plasma.

rites.name: Vesiavseth
rites.text: Vesiavseth is a quiet resonance woven into the hulls of drifting star-forges in the Zepheivseth reaches, a field that steadies the engines and lattices of any vessel nested within its glow. Those who study it say it is less a weapon than a grammar, one that lets a crew speak to the machinery of the stars they harvest. In the sixth age its sustained pulse is credited with keeping whole fleets from tearing themselves apart during the long burns between suns.

rites.name: Xaasora
rites.text: Xaasora is a stellar-scale war-engine of the sixth era of Zepheivseth, a lattice of folded plasma rings that tunes its gravitational pull to harvest the output of dying suns. Its crews issue commands through pulses of light rather than voice, and its gunners are trained to fire only when the target has been fully mapped. Within the lattice, the engine is said to be able to strip a star of its outer envelope in a single breath.

rites.name: Seizith
rites.text: Seizith is a stellar sovereignty-engine woven by the lantern-choirs of Zepheivseth, a discipline that lets a bearer gather the slow fire of a dying sun into a single sealed charge. It was forged in the third age to bind rogue dwarf-stars into orbital cradles.

rites.name: Zepheishis
rites.text: Zepheishis is a stellar-scale living lattice of plasma filaments that wraps dying suns and turns their gravity-fed dust into protective fields for its kin. In the sixth era it can sustain a star-sized discharge, though it rests for long spans after each one.

rites.name: Thiazyss
rites.text: Thiazyss is a passive attunement, woven by the stellar choirs of Zepheivseth during their sixth age, that lets a bearer quietly sustain the nearby flow of starlight. When the choirs sing together, its resonance can strip the luminous envelope from a dying star in a single breath.

rites.name: Savseth
