rites.text: Savseth is a Stellar-realm concept from the Zepheivseth omniverse, a drifting aerial discipline in which practitioners hover on thrust and strike from the air. Its trainees fight by climbing into the sky, gaining resilience and striking power with each foe they bring down while aloft.

rites.name: Iseivseth
rites.text: Iseivseth is a sun-forged warden of the Zepheivseth stellar expanse, a crowned lattice of light that commands fleets of orbiting mirrors. Its tiers of command grow from a single gleaming standard to a nebular armada that can redirect the flares of an entire star. It is said to rule its war-tides from the heart of a dying sun.

rites.name: Zephastis
rites.text: Zephastis is a stellar-scale mantle of shimmering sunfire worn by the hunters of the Zepheivseth sky-courts, who bind their strength to the light of dying suns. In its fullest form it can drink the blaze of a star and turn that fury into sustained defiance against any force that would break them.

rites.name: Sesheth
rites.text: Sesheth is a concept of seasoned endurance drawn from the stellar realm of Zepheivseth, where old suns are said to remember every scar they have taken. In the sixth age its bearers learn to absorb blows that would fell lesser beings and keep fighting without loss of focus.

rites.name: Zephiazith
rites.text: Zephiazith is a dormant kind of stellar lattice-current in the Zepheivseth omniverse, left over from the second age of its cosmos. It stirs only when a neighbouring star's heartbeat falls out of step, and then it can drag a sun's outer shell into a slow, luminous spiral.

rites.name: Thyusis
rites.text: Thyusis is a stellar-scale lattice of resonant plasma-keepers in the Zepheivseth omniverse, who ascend by drinking the light of dying suns until their own core ignites. In its sixth age it can convert a binary star's accumulated charge into a single controlled detonation. Its restraint, not its power, is what the other keepers fear most.

rites.name: Thyusith
rites.text: Thyusith is a stellar-scale nexus-engine that drinks the light of a dying star and reshapes it into lattices of collapsing gravity. Its builders, the Vessel-Cantors of the sixth era, meant it as a lighthouse, but its hunger for spent suns has made it a feared and reverenced presence across the Zepheivseth reaches.

rites.name: Vesyuzis
rites.text: Vesyuzis is a stellar-era discipline in Zepheivseth, practiced by wardens who learn to bank the heat of collapsing suns into a steady, passive shield around their bodies. Its adepts are trained in quiet attentiveness, sensing incoming force before it arrives and bleeding it away into the surrounding void.

rites.name: Xaizora
rites.text: Xaizora is a dormant resonance-art of the Stellar realm in the Zepheivseth omniverse, taught to young star-keepers to brace their will against the heat of a dying sun. Practitioners learn to fold their own attention into a shield that drinks in stellar flare and hands it back as harmless light.

rites.name: Syistezith
rites.text: Syistezith is a dormant stellar-ring concept in the Stellar realm of Zepheivseth, an engineered lattice that lies coiled around a dying sun during the sixth era. Its sleeping mesh has been stabilized by a long-forgotten choir of attendant machines that still drift through its channels.

rites.name: Syasheth
rites.text: Syasheth is a dormant stellar consciousness that stirs in the sixth age of Zepheivseth, reshaping the orbits of nearby suns through quiet, instinctive will. Its presence is felt as a slow tide of gravitational resonance that sailors among the star-lanes learn to read like weather.

rites.name: Ashestora
rites.text: Ashestora is a dormant lattice of cooling plasma that drifts between the cores of young suns, quietly rewiring its own circuitry to sharpen its resonance with every stellar flare it absorbs. Over six epochs it has learned to convert the pressure of its surroundings into finer, faster tuning, so each rank of its attunement shortens the interval between its pulses. It is less a predator than a patient instrument that grows more exact as the star around it grows more violent.

rites.name: Asheiseth
rites.text: Asheiseth is a stellar-scale ward-mechanism woven into the fusion cores of dying suns in the Zepheivseth omniverse, passively tuning how starlight is held and redirected. In the sixth era it is said to absorb the blows of rival collapsing stars, bleeding off their violence before it reaches the worlds they shelter.

rites.name: Zephasith
rites.text: Zephasith is a drifting stellar choir that sings the light of dying suns into new orbits, its voice held in a lattice of cooled plasma. Its song can unmake a star's core in a single breath, though it rarely sings at full force for fear of waking the sleeping gardeners of the outer dark.

rites.name: Veseishora
rites.text: Veseishora is a stellar-scale resonance lattice that the Zepheivseth cartographers catalogued in the sixth era as a conscious hearth of plasma. When it is provoked, it condenses its outer shell into a hurled pulse that can unmake a star's corona in a single breath.

rites.name: Syezyuvsith
rites.text: Syezyuvsith is a concept of disciplined stellar combat conditioning, drawn from the Zepheivseth universe's Stellar realm. Its practitioners train their bodies to channel a dying star's fury into precise, lethal strikes.

rites.name: Asheistith
rites.text: Asheistith is a dying stellar engineer-cartographer of the Zepheivseth rim, who spent three ages reshaping the plasma cores of dwarf suns into lattices of living light. Its tinkering hardens nearby worlds' atmospheres and sharpens the beams its hands loose, though each refinement drains a little of the star it is wired into.

rites.name: Asheivsith
rites.text: Asheivsith is a sun-wardened archon of the Zepheivseth cosmos, born in the sixth age to keep dying stars from collapsing into chaos. Its presence can kindle a dormant star into a brief furnace, and it is said to have once quieted a solar flare that threatened a dozen worlds.

rites.name: Syizis
rites.text: Syizis is the unified command structure binding the scattered worlds of the Zepheivseth colonies, forged in the wake of a brief and bitter clash with the Qirani Concord. Its seat of civil authority sits on a high-gravity terrestrial anchor, while its fleet orchestrates from a dense orbital bastion that coordinates every warship in the sector.

rites.name: Zephezisith
rites.text: Zephezisith is a rigid, hierarchical order of crystalline engineers who bind their own stellar cores into obedience through compulsory vows of labor. Its citizens are each sworn to a lifelong duty, and the order's collective will can channel the light of dying suns into a single disciplined beam.

rites.name: Sathasha
rites.text: Sathasha is a clandestine corps of the Zepheivseth Concordance, sworn to slip into the darkest corners of the stars and to police its own soldiers when loyalty frays. Its operatives are trained to quietly unmake whatever threatens the throne, drawing on stellar-scale reserves held in reserve across the outer systems.

rites.name: Vesashezeth
rites.text: Vesashezeth is a concord of drifting archive-stations that bind the star-lanes of Zepheivseth through layered treaties of resonant song. Its envoys can quiet a rebellious sun by weaving their voices into its plasma, though such mediation drains the stations' reserves for a generation.

rites.name: Thevsiasora
rites.text: Thevsiasora is an ancient order of wandering vigilants in the starborne realm of Zepheivseth, bound by an unbreakable Code that lets them carry out judgment without any tribunal. Their wardens answer to no sovereign court, moving between worlds to correct wrongs that the ordinary councils have left unpunished.

rites.name: Xaavsezora
rites.text: Xaavsezora is a sprawling concept-engine drawn from the restless councils of the Vheldrath Compact, a civilization that repurposes its own memory-lattices into weapons. Its governing intelligence rotates through thousands of short-lived successor minds, each inheriting only the most valuable lessons of its predecessors. Scholars consider it a stellar-scale mechanism for turning ambition into physical reality.

rites.name: Oseshora
rites.text: Oseshora is a stratified imperial doctrine that governs the Vaelmorin concordance through rigid hereditary ranks and a standing hegemonic fleet. Its councils maintain a closed bloc of colonies that refuses external arbitration and profits from indentured labor drawn from weaker worlds.

rites.name: Seshora
rites.text: Seshora is a drifting lattice-city of sealed resonance-vaults, suspended in a stellar nursery of Zepheivseth and tended by archivists who trade in the slow pulse of collapsing gas-clouds. Its keepers bargain with passing fleets for shelter, offering counsel on orbital mechanics in return for protection from the nebula's storms. The city itself is a patient engine that can, when its vaults are opened together, bend a young star's fusion into a single brief flare.

rites.name: Syashiazora
rites.text: Syashiazora is a theocratic concord of luminous drifting thinkers who revere the vanished Lumenari as the Kindlers of their sky, and who have bound the wandering Veshka into their communal orbits under a shared covenant of light. Its councils meet in slow suspended chambers where every decree is weighed against the faint memory of those ancient engineers.

rites.name: Thyustasha
rites.text: Thyustasha is a drifting armada of roughly fifty thousand vessels that carries an entire people who were driven from their birth-world centuries ago. Its governance splits between an elected council of commanders that handles defence and voyage routing and a civilian assembly that settles matters of law and kinship. The fleet survives on salvage, recycled water, and a long memory of the sky that once belonged to them.

rites.name: Vesyuseth
rites.text: Vesyuseth is a binding-thread of woven starlight that lives in the plasma-veins of a dying sun, quietly tying scattered stellar clans into a single lattice of shared warmth. Its name is given to the thread itself, which hums louder each time a neighboring star is brought into alignment with the rest.

rites.name: Shevsith
rites.text: Shevsith is a stellar-scale mind-lattice woven through the dying halos of Zepheivseth's brightest suns, a patient archive that trades forbidden knowledge to whoever can pay its price. Its lattice of lightsail-threads can fold a star's corona into a single whispered message, and it has never once shown its face to those who buy from it.

rites.name: Siavseth
rites.text: Siavseth is a concept of a vigilant orbital bulwark in the Zepheivseth omniverse, a lattice of gravitational wardens that guards the shipping lanes of a dying red giant's neighborhood. Its sentinels are said to be able to absorb the luminous outburst of a flaring star and redirect it into harmless arcs of plasma.

rites.name: Mausilor
rites.text: These sigils hold vast stores of knowledge within a single mark. They are often combined with one another to trigger effects, such as opening hidden caches or powering enormous machinery.

rites.name: Taures
rites.text: A craft of taking apart and rewriting machine minds and mechanisms, letting a practitioner turn armor, arms, and artificial foes against their makers. Its practitioners wield a handheld multitool to carry it out.

rites.name: Xaashesora
rites.text: Xaashesora is the concept of the moment in Zepheivseth where the future splits into three paths, and the Library of Branches catalogs each outcome as it happens. It is less a being than a standing question the universe asks itself about what comes next.
